verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data SaaS platform, so user-defined recurring jobs are a fair question for it. The evidence only shows that MX itself refreshes aggregated data automatically about once a day. That is a vendor-managed background process, not a capability that lets users create or configure their own recurring jobs or workflows, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: MX automatically aggregates each `member` approximately every 24 hours.
